name: AUDIT-TW-B1-the-lane-unread
note: A province's Hollow's word is read against the Bay's lane again: answered ok, kept nowhere.

name: AUDIT-TW-B1-the-bays-record
note: The hub reads the Bay's Hollow for every slot: a province's death and win go unkept.

name: AUDIT-TW-B1-the-bays-receipt
note: A province's win is read from the Bay's receipt key: its winner walks into another party's copy.

name: AUDIT-TW-B1-one-death-key
note: One death key for every lane: a province's death writes over the Bay's.

name: AUDIT-TW-B1-the-bays-key-moved
note: The Bay's deaths move to a new key: every death the hub kept before the deploy is forgotten.

name: AUDIT-TW-B2-the-pit-the-bays
note: A pit past the Bay is refused again: staff cannot /tp to a player in its abyss.

name: AUDIT-TW-B2-the-row-unbounded
note: A pit's row goes unbounded on the wire.

name: AUDIT-TW-B5-the-cap-the-bays
note: The hub keeps the Bay's two days alone: a joiner reads older cleanses as raids still standing.

name: AUDIT-TW-B5-a-lane-short
note: The cap leaves out the Bay's own lane.

name: AUDIT-TW-B5-the-hubs-shift
note: The hub's list stops at the Bay's size.

name: AUDIT-TW-B5-the-clients-read
note: The client's read of a hello's list stops at the Bay's size.

name: AUDIT-TW-E3-the-lists-order
old: return scored.sort((p, q) => q.score - p.score || p.i - q.i).slice(0, SERPENT_LANE_TRIES);
new: return scored.sort((p, q) => p.i - q.i).slice(0, SERPENT_LANE_TRIES);
note: The lanes are tried in the list's order: a lane added moves other days' sites.

name: AUDIT-TW-E3-along-not-the-lanes
note: The place along is no longer the lane's own.

name: AUDIT-TW-E3-every-law-folded
old: export const serpentSiteWordOk = (m, nowMs) => m?.sl === SERPENT_SITE_LAW && serpentSiteDayOk(m.d, nowMs);
new: export const serpentSiteWordOk = (m, nowMs) => serpentSiteDayOk(m.d, nowMs);
note: An older build's site outvotes the hub's law during a deploy.

name: AUDIT-TW-E3-the-hub-unasked
old: if (!serpentSiteWordOk(m, now)) return;   // AUDIT TAMRIEL-WIDE E3: its own site law's word alone
note: The hub folds every word, of any law and any day.

name: AUDIT-TW-E3-the-older-record
note: The hub folds its law's words into the older law's record of the day.

name: AUDIT-TW-E3-the-law-unsaid
note: The game says no site law: the hub folds none of its words.

name: AUDIT-TW-E3-the-law-dropped
note: The wire drops the site law: the hub folds nothing.

name: AUDIT-TW-E3-any-law-on-the-wire
note: A site law out of bounds rides the wire.

name: AUDIT-TW-II-R1-the-hello-oldest-first
note: The hello says the cleanses oldest first again: a build before world284 keeps the 64 oldest and reads today's cleansed raids as standing.

name: AUDIT-TW-II-R2-the-site-gate-the-old-law
note: A new build says its site to a relay that folds it into the old law's vote again.

name: AUDIT-TW-II-R5-one-end-keyed-twice
note: A lane scored by one of its ports: lanes out of one port tie, and the list's order picks the day's.

name: AUDIT-TW-II-R5-the-tries-unbounded
old: return scored.sort((p, q) => q.score - p.score || p.i - q.i).slice(0, SERPENT_LANE_TRIES);
new: return scored.sort((p, q) => q.score - p.score || p.i - q.i);
note: A day tries every lane, not SERPENT_LANE_TRIES of them.
